notes: Single source of truth for both deliverables in this repo.
The prototype serves this file verbatim (vite publicDir = repo shared/); the iOS app bundles it as a resource via ios/project.yml.
No sync step: if a note here changes, both surfaces change together.
comments[].provenance: sample = hand-typed exemplar phrasing; live = fetched from a public metadata mirror and kept as-is.
excludedExamples are things a lofi app must refuse: they feed the gate test, not the UI.
Tracklists were read off watch pages; verify against the live video before shipping.
